title: Action executed
description: The outcome of an allowed call, or of a provider-run call that a model's response reports (EP-18).

decision_id.description: The id of the decision.made event that allowed the call. Required, except with origin provider: no decision precedes a provider-run call that the provider did not submit for approval (EP-18).

resource.description: What the call applied to (section 6.3). A tool's or a model's ID is its key in the catalog, or, for tooling that the catalog does not list, its name as the agent sees it, with reference_sha256 (section 8.3).

origin.description: Who ran the tool, for a tool resource: the agent, or its model provider (section 4.10).

reference_sha256.description: For a tool or a model that the catalog does not list: the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the string form of its reference, in lowercase hexadecimal (sections 4.10 and 8.3).

error_type.description: The error's type or code, never its message, which may hold personal data.
